styles.name: Cutaway
styles.summary: A block of land cut out of the world: a living landscape on top, clean strata on the cut faces, clear water, surprises in the soil.
styles.best_for: what lies under the surface: cities, digs, geology, nature, how things work underground; ads for trades

styles.name: Cutaway seasons loop
styles.summary: The Cutaway base grammar since 23 Oct: one fixed view, no cuts, a living world changing through the seasons.
styles.best_for: social loops, ambient and music films, brand loops; every art look is ported onto it

styles.name: Cutaway cinematic
styles.summary: The kit with cinema light, mist, animals and buried surprises, shot with moving cameras and cuts; Sam did not like the test.
styles.best_for: set pieces inside another film (the Agincourt inserts) and explainers that need many angles

styles.name: Battle Map
styles.summary: A 3D relief map that reads as drawn and engraved, armies as soldier figures on trays, ink arrows, a legend, labels in code.
styles.best_for: battles, campaigns, journeys, expeditions: anything about places and movement

styles.name: Kinetic
styles.summary: Words, dates, numbers and documents in motion on one lit desk, restrained and adult, every word inside the phone safe box.
styles.best_for: true stories told through words and documents: history, science, ideas

styles.name: Lantern Road
styles.summary: Painterly storybook sets at true depths (a 2.5D multiplane), lanterns that relight the paint, slow real moves.
styles.best_for: dark history told as a fable; NOOR (reverent, no figures)

styles.name: Clay
styles.summary: Thumb-sized clay figures and handmade sets in Blender, poses on twos, deadpan timing.

styles.name: Blueprint
styles.summary: An engineering drawing: cyanotype blue, drafting grid, hatched soil symbols, depth ruler and dimensions.
styles.best_for: civil, geotechnical and drilling firms, infrastructure start-ups, engineering schools

styles.name: Chalkboard
styles.summary: The cutaway drawn in chalk on a slate board: dusty white outlines, a few coloured sticks, smudged layers.
styles.best_for: teachers and course brands, museum education, soil-testing and garden businesses

styles.name: Claymation
styles.summary: Plasticine stop-motion: every material clay with lumps, thumb prints and tool marks.
styles.best_for: family, kids, toy and food brands, museum and children's TV explainers, mascot shorts

styles.name: Engraving
styles.summary: A 19th-century encyclopaedia plate: sepia copperplate hatching on cream paper that follows the forms.
styles.best_for: history channels and heritage trusts, illustrated history publishers, firms with old roots

styles.name: Fable
styles.summary: A mid-century storybook painting in gouache: jewel palette, painted sky and sun halos, tall decorative trees.
styles.best_for: children's and family brands, museums and parks, terroir and luxury hospitality; the Fable music film

styles.name: Flat vector
styles.summary: The Cutaway as a 2D web film: flat shapes and clean labels, renders in minutes in Chromium.
styles.best_for: weekly explainer series, trade and local business ads in both formats, data and infographic pieces

styles.name: Night glow
styles.summary: The block at night, alive with light: stars, a pale moon, glowing roots, finds that burn warm.
styles.best_for: natural history museums and science centres, night events and gaming, sleep and calm apps

styles.name: Papercraft
styles.summary: Layered cut paper under a desk lamp: posterised card colours, torn-edged strata sheets, drop shadows.
styles.best_for: children's book publishers and museum exhibits, craft brands, schools and science channels

styles.name: Pixel
styles.summary: A 16-bit game diorama: rendered small, Bayer dither, a fixed 32-colour palette, scaled up crisp.
styles.best_for: game studios and indie launches, retro-gaming and developer brands, educational games

styles.name: Risograph
styles.summary: A riso print in three spot inks (fluorescent pink, teal, yellow) through coarse halftone screens.
styles.best_for: posters, album and festival art, cultural institutions, craft food and drink

styles.name: Stained glass
styles.summary: A leaded Art Nouveau window (secular, no figures): jewel panes held by dark lead lines.
styles.best_for: heritage and craft brands, wineries and terroir food, cultural seasons and festivals

styles.name: Storybook ink
styles.summary: A children's picture book: ink lines over a soft, hand-made picture.
styles.best_for: children's publishers and parenting brands, museum family trails, school and library films

workflows.name: Render a film on runners
workflows.summary: Any film folder rendered in parallel parts on free runners, joined with its own sound.
workflows.run: rc-render films.yml (REST dispatch: film, parts, ref)

workflows.name: Check stills
workflows.summary: Full-quality single frames of a film folder on free runners, before any full render.
workflows.run: rc-render stills.yml (REST dispatch: film, frames, tag, w, h, samples, per_job, ref)

workflows.name: Render on the Mac lane
workflows.summary: Blender films on Sam's M4 GPU from his Samsung X5 drive, about 7 runners' worth.
workflows.run: a job JSON in KINOFORGE/render/mac-jobs/ on the drive; lane started by harness/mac/go.py in Blender

workflows.name: Remux sound
workflows.summary: New sound on a finished film without re-rendering the picture.

workflows.name: Follow-up chains
workflows.summary: A render that waits for other renders, checked every 15 minutes on GitHub.
workflows.run: a rule line in rc-render .github/workflows/chain.yml (cron, or REST dispatch)

workflows.name: Fetch music
workflows.summary: A public domain or CC0 recording from Wikimedia Commons with its licence record.

workflows.name: Build the sound bank
workflows.summary: The BigSoundBank CC0 recordings as one checked archive with loudness.

workflows.name: Narration and score
workflows.summary: Free narration (Kokoro or Chatterbox), the procedural score and the mix for a film folder.

workflows.name: Director pipeline
workflows.summary: An approved brief in, a checked and rendered film out, inside a hard money cap.
workflows.run: push films/studio/<id>/brief.json, or kinoforge film.yml (REST dispatch: job, from)

workflows.name: Web studio build button
workflows.summary: The studio's "Build this film" commits the brief that starts the director.

workflows.name: Social videos
workflows.summary: Phone-format batch videos from code templates, one runner per video (lane paused).

workflows.name: Code ads
workflows.summary: Business ads built in code, music first: prep then render (lane paused).

workflows.name: Style boards and AI footage
workflows.summary: Paid AI stills and clips for a style board, and the AI-footage shot factory.
workflows.run: kinoforge board.yml and piece.yml (REST dispatch; Sam's go per job)

workflows.name: Legacy lanes
workflows.summary: The 13 to 16 Oct lanes kept for history: gallery, showcase, voice, finish, director.yml, motion, smoke.
workflows.run: see the page; not used for new work
